emma (docs): quick flag found a small class of broken anchors after the migration: fenced code blocks with language hints (```js) are stripping the nearby heading anchor in the docusaurus build. linkcheck is failing on several cross-page links. example: docs/sdk/usage.md links to docs/sdk/examples#usage-snippet but the built page only has the snippet visible without the anchor. sam (eng): any sample output from the static build? that helps me see whether remark-slug is generating something odd or the parser is dropping the h tag near the fenced block. emma (docs): pasted output from the static render: `...
` followed immediately by the following heading text which gets folded into the same block instead of an 
. looks like a markdown parsing edge when there's no blank line between the code fence and heading.

aj (devex): ah yes -- CommonMark requires a blank line before a ATX heading following a code fence in some parsers. We should either lint enforce a blank line or postprocess and add missing heading ids.

lila (i18n): careful: auto-adding ids could collide in translated pages where headings are localized. we should prefer to fix the source docs where possible, then fallback to generated redirects/ids per locale.

ci-bot: linkcheck: 5 broken links found in PR preview. failing routes: /sdk/usage -> target /sdk/examples#usage-snippet, /api/streams -> target /api/streams#streaming-examples. linkcheck-run-id: lc-2026-03-23-01.

emma (docs): plan proposal: 1) run a docs-lint step that fails if a heading immediately follows a code fence without a blank line 2) add a fast post-build pass that inserts missing ids when headings are present but parsed inside pre/code 3) update contributing doc and add an example in the SDK snippets guide

aj (devex): I can add the markdownlint rule `MD012` or a custom rule to catch the fence+heading pattern. also we can add a remark plugin to enforce blank-line-before-heading transformation.
